Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Hold up there -- you're the ones who dropped at the last footfall, aren't you? I heard you cleared it before the ground even finished shaking.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Word travels faster than we do, apparently. What do you need?

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Not a thing -- I'm offering. I've been riding a few wagons back of every crew since the wells turned, and a caravan this size could use another set of wheels. Let me ride with you?

Choices.Label: First, sell us a map. (20 G)

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Smart. Here -- the roads past the valley, marked true, and a tonic for the nerves. On the house, since you're paying for the ink.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Suit yourselves. I'll follow a few wagons back all the same -- somebody has to sell you rope when you run out.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Good. Find my wagon at camp whenever you need supplies -- and don't let that caravan guard talk you into anything expensive.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: So this is really how it works -- we drop, we clear, we grab what's useful, and she just... keeps walking.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: That's the whole trade, far as I've ever seen it. Stand still too long anywhere on this road and you'll learn why she doesn't.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: You're the crew that cleared the slime nest? I watched from the ridge -- didn't think three of you would still be standing.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: We nearly weren't. We could use another pair of hands, if you're offering.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Dangerous is why I'm still out here instead of back where the wells turned. I can handle it.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Then that's settled. Where this caravan's headed, it'll want someone who can still cast a straight line.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: That's the road clear behind us, for now. Feels like the first time any of us has stopped moving in days.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: You look it. I've got a wagon with real beds, not bedrolls on a cart floor -- first good sleep since the wells turned sour, if you'll have it.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: Shall I hitch my wagon to yours, then?

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: A fair price for people who clear footfalls for a living. I wasn't going to charge you much anyway.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: Good. Rest at camp whenever the road wears you down -- the Longmother doesn't stop, but you're allowed to.

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: That gear of yours is chewed half through. Whatever you've been fighting, it's eating your steel faster than you can swing it.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Faster than we'd like. Can it be mended?

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: Mended, reforged, melted down for something better -- whatever it needs. Take me along and you'll never fight on a notched blade again. Well?

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: Fair. Bring the worst of it to my forge-cart at camp and watch -- it'll come back whole before your stew's cold.

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: Good. Find me at the forge-cart before something breaks -- once it shatters, there's nothing left to mend.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Travelers -- thank every working gear in creation. The sand took my cart two days back and the goblin digs further in are not polite company.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Ride with the caravan, then. We're headed through the Reaches ourselves.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: I've rebuilt worse than danger out of spare parts. Danger I can work with.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Then my tools are yours. Fair warning -- I fix things that are already broken a lot better than I avoid breaking them in the first place.

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Hold on -- what's that hanging off your packs? Pelts, wings, glands... Most crews sell those to the Merchant for coppers. Bottled right, they close a wound.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: What are you brewing all the way out here?

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Whatever your crews pull off the things you kill. Venom, ichor, pelt -- it's all reagent if you know how to read it, and a potion brewed costs a fraction of one bought. Need a brewer?

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Mostly. I'm coming either way -- the road's not safe for a brewer working alone, and lately neither is a clean spell.

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Good. Here -- a clean bottle for your first brew. Find me at camp with those trophies; the Merchant sells more bottles for a few coins.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: The works under these dunes aren't the Longmother's leavings -- those digs are older than her whole stride through here.

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Older than her stride, maybe. Not older than whatever's souring the ground. That didn't start with us, and it isn't finishing with us either.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Who goes there, in the Frostmaw dark? Answer slow -- I've had worse than bandits down this pass.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Friends, if you'll have us. We're with the caravan on the Longmother's back.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: I've held this pass alone a full season. Danger and I are well acquainted.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Then my shield walks with you. Whatever's down here that's built and not grown, I want to see it fall as much as you do.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: That thing we pulled out of the ice wasn't grown. It was built. On purpose.

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: I've forged enough to know the difference between an accident and a design. That was a design. Somebody made that, somewhere, a long time before we ever got here.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Hold still -- you're bleeding from that last stretch of ruin and you don't even seem to know it.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Mend us, and march with us. We won't say no to either.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: The ruins are worse than anything on the road behind you. I'd rather face them with company.

Nodes.Speaker: recruit
Nodes.Text: Then I'll keep you standing. Whatever's waiting in here that refuses to lie down, we're going to make sure it finally does.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: A dead city that tried to just... stay. No Longmother, no walking, just walls.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: And it still didn't work. Whatever's waiting in there has had longer than anyone to learn what staying still actually costs.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: The Vampire Lord's down, and we're back in green country. I almost thought that was the end of it.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: It never was going to be. She can't walk back over ground she's already woken, so she curls instead -- and we end up somewhere that looks like home and isn't. Deeper in than the old road ever ran.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: This isn't rare anymore. Half of what we're fighting out here is half-built like that thing near the ridge.

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Out past the Reaches, it's the norm, not the exception. We give the strong ones a single name, like it's one throne and not a condition. I don't think it's one throne.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Those markings on the wreck back there -- that's not our caravan's make.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: No. Somebody else was working this ground before us, and didn't get the chance to leave. Past the mire, nobody comes this far who still has somewhere better to be.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: The ore's thinner down here. Half of what we're hauling up doesn't burn clean anymore.

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: Then we stop trusting it to burn clean and start trusting it less. Whatever's down at the bottom of these veins isn't interested in making this easy for us.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: We're past where the Vampire Lord held, and the ruins just... keep going. Older under older.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: Then the road's not done asking its question. We've beaten what was standing in the doorway. We still don't know what built the house.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: You followed my lights a long way to show me fresh armor. Honest work -- but it's only leather and stitching. It could be more.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: More how? Who are you?

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: One who binds workings into what you wear instead of trusting them to the air. A rune in a jerkin can knit wounds, keep out venom, or bite back at whatever strikes it. Your caravan could use that.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: Fair enough -- there. Bound tight enough to last a march; most spells aren't, anymore.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: Good. Take this pinch of Arcane Dust -- bring it to my table with a few trophies from the road, and I'll bind your first rune into that armor for nothing.

Nodes.Speaker: lead
Nodes.Text: Every fen's worse than the last fen. That's not a feeling anymore, that's just the route.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: Because the blight pools where the ground's low and wet, same as anything else that doesn't like to keep moving. We're walking into exactly what it likes best.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Welcome back. Wares, news, or just killing time before the next footfall?

Choices.Label: Can your guard join us? (300 G)

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: That map's good as far as the Reaches -- past that, you're trusting the same ruts I am.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Already forgotten. A crew that turns away a stranger on a bad road isn't wrong to, most days.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Good man. Treat my guard well -- he's saved my hide more than the map ever has.

Nodes.Speaker: merchant
Nodes.Text: Safe roads. Mind the wells.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: Beds are made, water's hot. What's keeping you up?

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: Travelers talk more than they think when they're warm and fed. I just listen -- you'd be surprised what a crew says the night after a bad footfall.

Nodes.Speaker: innkeeper
Nodes.Text: Sleep while you can. The ground doesn't wait for anyone, but you've earned the night.

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: Mind the sparks. What do you need -- mended, or melted down?

Choices.Label: Where did you learn the trade?

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: My mother's forge, a long time before the wells turned. She worked shed-plate same as I do now. Guess some trades just keep walking.

Nodes.Speaker: smith
Nodes.Text: Bring me something broken. There's always something broken.

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Don't touch the green one. What do you need?

Choices.Label: What does the green one do?

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Not entirely sure yet. That's half the reason it's still in the flask and not in somebody's potion belt.

Nodes.Speaker: alchemist
Nodes.Text: Bring me reagents. The good kind come off the things that still twitch after you've killed them.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: The runes are restless tonight. What do you need?

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: They hum, faint, when something's close that magic doesn't like the shape of. Out here, that's most nights.

Nodes.Speaker: enchantress
Nodes.Text: Sleep lightly. I'll be listening to the steel.

Nodes.Speaker: hero
Nodes.Text: Didn't expect to be out here when the season started, if I'm honest. Strange how fast normal changes.

Choices.Label: What do you make of the merchant?

Nodes.Speaker: hero
Nodes.Text: Tired. Everyone's tired. But we're still standing, and that counts for something out here.

Nodes.Speaker: hero
Nodes.Text: He talks too much and prices everything, but he hasn't steered us wrong yet. I'll take it.

Nodes.Speaker: hero
Nodes.Text: You too. Try to actually sleep -- the ground'll still be there in the morning. Probably.
